# Moji Studios

> Indie game studio (est. 2026) crafting early-2000s-style retro games with hand-pixeled art. Main game: MojiWorld, a 2D side-scrolling adventure launching first as a single-player game on Steam (expected July–August 2026), with a full online MMORPG planned after launch. Also: Bitmon (creature-breeding RPG, in development) and Chubby Bird (free browser arcade game, live now).

Key facts:
- MojiWorld: hand-pixeled 2D side-scrolling adventure; single-player first on Steam, expected July–August 2026; full MMORPG after launch; 12 classes; 8 continents planned; price TBA.
- Bitmon: creature-breeding RPG; 240+ hand-pixeled creatures; genetics, lineage and personality systems; online trading; in development, release date TBA.
- Chubby Bird: free one-button casual arcade game, playable now in the browser at https://moji-studios.com/chubbybird/.
- Mascot: Guguma (named after sweet potatoes).
- Contact: admin@moji-studios.com · Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/mojistudios.official/
